reason_for_revision: The three-layer candidate conflated artifact identity with executed lineage and omitted question-specific diagnostic sufficiency.

axes.name: ARTIFACT_IDENTITY_AND_AUTHORITY
axes.question: Are the exact bytes, version, sample, and ordering uniquely identified?

axes.name: NUMERICAL_OUTPUT_TRACEABILITY
axes.question: Can the declared output or headline quantity be recovered under a frozen contract?

axes.name: MATHEMATICAL_EQUIVALENCE_AND_REPRESENTATION_INVARIANCE
axes.question: Does the result survive tested mathematically equivalent representations and solver policies?

axes.name: DIAGNOSTIC_SUFFICIENCY_AND_ADEQUACY
axes.question: Does the representation retain the residual and goodness-of-fit information needed for the diagnostic question?

axes.name: EXECUTED_LINEAGE_AND_PROVENANCE
axes.question: Can the exact input-to-configuration-to-run-to-final-output chain be uniquely traced?

axes.name: GENERATIVE_AND_CAUSAL_CLOSURE
axes.question: Is the covariance, truth model, pipeline validity, or physical cause supported?
